messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT — Canary rollout 2026-03-17 04:52 UTC for model-serving v2.3.1 -> 5xx spike (0.2% -> 4.6%) in eu-west-1. Metrics: https://grafana/reports/abc123
ops-pager: Paging Priya S. (oncall) — pager fired
Priya S.: I'm on it, looking at metrics and logs. Can someone pause canary traffic and flip the safety flag?
Sam R.: Pausing canary traffic now. Flipping feature flag canary_v2 -> OFF
Sam R.: /ff flip canary_v2 off --reason "5xx spike in eu-west canary" :white_check_mark:
Jess K.: 5xxs look like tokenizer/middleware NPEs, sample log:
```
2026-03-17T04:50:12Z ERROR middleware/tokenizer: nil pointer deref at tokenize.go:88
```
Lucy (support): Support reports customer errors on /v1/embeddings for large-batch requests. Affected: AcmeCorp, DataFirm.
Priya S.: Setting status to degraded. Notify CS and keep customers updated. Next: try quick revert of the single commit that landed in canary yesterday.
Sam R.: I can revert 3f2e1a7b (tokenizer change). Plan: git revert -> hotpatch to canary -> validate -> ramp.
Sam R.: Commands I'll run:
```
git checkout release/v2
git revert --no-edit 3f2e1a7b
git push origin release/v2
# CI will trigger hotpatch job: hotpatch-deploy --env=eu-west-1 --strategy=canary
```
Priya S.: +1. Limit canary to 10% and watch the error budget. Oncall-Bot, open a deployment window.
Oncall-Bot: Deployment window approved for hotpatch 1717004321. Canary cap: 10% (eu-west-1).
Sam R.: Hotpatch queued -> deploying reverted commit to canary. Logs: https://elk/logs/hotpatch/1717004321
Jess K.: 2 minutes after revert: 5xx dropped from 4.6% -> 0.4%. Monitoring continues.
Lucy (support): Notifying affected customers: "We saw elevated errors and have deployed a rollback. No data loss expected. We'll follow up when fully validated."
Priya S.: If stable at 10% for 10m, ramp to 100% in 15m. Documenting RCA: missing nil guard in tokenizer change. Postmortem template started.
Sam R.: Follow-up PR incoming adding nil checks and unit tests to tokenize path. Will include a small smoke test for large-batch requests. :thumbsup:
Lucy (support): Tickets created for AcmeCorp / DataFirm; CSMs looped in.
Priya S.: Handoff to morning oncall (Jess K.) at 08:00 UTC for validation and post-incident actions. Incident severity: Sev2. Closing pager after monitoring window. Over.
